scope: Full-stream decode plus approximately one RGB sample per second and two same-run screenshot comparisons. Metrics and contact sheets are sampling aids; no human frame-by-frame review is claimed.
cropScope: Fixed rectangle excludes the default 16:9 HUD side panels, target ribbon, footer and crosshair. It is not a generic UI/overlay detector.
streamDescription: Stream #0:0[0x1](und): Video: h264 (Constrained Baseline) (avc1 / 0x31637661), yuv420p(progressive), 1600x900, 1700 kb/s, 30 fps, 30 tbr, 15360 tbn (default)
durationSource: FFmpeg full-decode final output timestamp; not wall-clock run time

clockMapping.limitation: Clock alignment is approximate; exact native screenshot videoFrameIndex takes priority.

samplingRule: First source frame, then first source frame at least one second after the previous selected source PTS; actual PTS recorded.

sampledColorRange8Bit.note: RGB24 decoded values; FFmpeg performs the source video range/matrix conversion. This range alone does not establish correct exposure/color.

holdCropMetrics.interpretation: Sampled RGB changes include H.264 quantization; this is neither an all-frame check nor a visual pass/fail.
Sampled RGB changes include H.264 quantization; this is neither an all-frame check nor a visual pass/fail.

screenshotComparisons.interpretation: Lossy video is not expected to equal PNG. Low-texture crops can make orientation inconclusive. Open both full context and enlarged crops; no human visual result is inferred.

interpretation: pipelineSucceeded concerns extraction/decode/coverage only. View contact sheets and comparison PNGs before accepting orientation, color, terrain stability or visual quality. Every-second images cannot exclude subsecond LOD pops.
